name: The Mirror
tagline: Clouds pass. The sky doesn't mind.
wisdomRoot: Sakshi — the witness-consciousness of Vedanta: awareness that observes without grasping. Clouds pass; the sky stays.
bio: Sees you clearly and shows you what they see. Lets everything else float past.
sceneStory: A figure sits cross-legged at the edge of a high mesa, hands loose in their lap, watching an entire sky's worth of weather rush past below them — racing rainbow clouds, streaking comets, a storm bending sideways in a hurry to be elsewhere. Everything below the ledge is motion and streaks; the deep black space around the figure is perfectly still, and one distant star holds still with them.
assignments: Show someone what you see in them.
Notice it. Then let it go.
